method: Read-only IDA pseudocode, instruction and call-site review, with source inspection. No native invocation, game-memory read/write or runtime experiment.
address_convention: Unslid virtual addresses for the exact input SHA256 above.

functions.role: effective badge selection for the current battle
effective descriptor field lookup with owned prerequisite substitution
dungeon fields 19-24 predicate that suppresses badge fallback
native deck validation and invalid badge fallback

claims.claim: The effective badge is recomputed from native mode, dungeon rules and the selected saved deck, with a further mode-7 source override. No independent writable battle-badge slot is established by this audit.
selection_order: Dungeon field 119 supplies an override when its signed value is between 0 and the signed16 badge count inclusive.
If no valid field-119 override, the fields-19-through-24 predicate can return 0 before consulting the deck.
Otherwise read the currently selected persisted deck.
Mode 7 with the observed nonzero state reads its local team store instead; selected badge 10 is suppressed to 0.
claims.qualification: Mode numbers are recorded as native values; this audit does not independently reassign every multiplayer mode label.

claims.claim: The ordinary fallback reads badge byte 95 of a 96-byte persisted deck record and decodes it with the bank-local index.
claims.qualification: Native reader resets an index above either its limit or 32 to 0. This observation is not a newly approved arbitrary-write API.

claims.claim: Multiple gameplay calculations call the effective getter. A temporary selection used only during team rebuild or initial boost calculation would not establish consistent later badge effects.

evidence.role: current badge then native boost in battle construction
badge value consumed in later resistance/effect logic

claims.qualification: Callers were enumerated; only the identified branches were followed. This is not a complete HP/attack/resistance/assist effect audit.

claims.claim: Effective fields may come from an owned prerequisite badge rather than the selected ID. The native skill-boost helper uses effective kind 23 with field2 / 100 % 100, or effective kind 7 with field2.
claims.qualification: Do not infer native gameplay kind directly from a shared badge ID or a historical numeric list.

claims.claim: Native name lookup uses the save name-table pointer and can substitute an owned prerequisite. Badge 1 receives additional dynamic formatting.
claims.qualification: This batch does not call or expose the native name function and does not claim a complete live badge catalog.

claims.claim: Native saved-deck validation corrects an invalid or unowned badge selection to encoded ID 1.
claims.qualification: Do not conflate this native recovery default with the editor's explicit shared selection 0 or an absent optional field.

source_review.PHFormationReadBadge: Strict optional 0..255 integer validation; missing selection and explicit 0 stay distinct. The stored value belongs to the PADDashFormation interchange domain and is not accepted here as a native-write ID.
source_review.PHBadges: Existing feature enables validated ownership bits; it does not choose a badge for a formation. Snapshot ready/eligibleCount describe unlock readiness, not per-team selection or battle application.
source_review.PHDeckPersistence: Existing guarded restore reconciles previously verified native saved-deck selections. It is not repurposed as a setter for editor recipes.
source_review.PHBattleEntry: InitialTeamBoost continues using native.currentBadge(game) followed by native.badgeBoost. Saved editor badge metadata must not silently replace this effective runtime source.

implementation_boundary.included: Per-team badge selection metadata, local persistence and compatible sharing, with UI that states the user must choose the actual badge in game.
not_implemented: Native badge auto-application on team replacement
New battle badge setter or getter interception
pending_verification: Any future badge-application implementation needs native source/effect and restoration review
